title: 🛫 Discover LFBH La Rochelle Airport in MSFS! 🌍
description:
Fly into the picturesque LFBH La Rochelle Airport, now available for Microsoft Flight Simulator! 🛩️ This detailed add-on features photorealistic buildings, including the exclusive Elixir Aircraft hangar and the newly renovated passenger terminal. Experience the charm of the Charente-Maritime region as you pilot the versatile Cessna 172 Skyhawk, navigating through the meticulously crafted runways and taxiways. Whether you’re exploring the beautiful Île de Ré or embarking on a cross-country journey, La Rochelle Airport offers an immersive experience for all aviation enthusiasts. Don’t miss out on adding this iconic airport to your MSFS collection! ✈️✨

For a full overview of new airports and scenery enhancements added to the marketplace this week have a look at the video below:
